columns.name: z
columns.unit: SET TO 0.0 AS A LENSTOOL PLACEHOLDER -- not a measured redshift; the cluster redshift z = 0.375 is assumed

extraction: Verbatim upstream ASCII, byte-for-byte unmodified. Whitespace-delimited.
note: Abell 370. cluster-member galaxies actually used in the Niemiec+2023 lens models: red-sequence members plus 20 non-red-sequence galaxies, magF814W < 22.6. MEASURED per galaxy: RA, Dec, F814W MAG_AUTO, and the SExtractor shape moments a, b, theta -- so axis ratio q = b/a and position angle ARE available. Effective radius R_e and Sersic index n are NOT: no Sersic fit is provided. TRAP: the z column is a hard-coded 0.0 LENSTOOL placeholder, NOT a measured redshift. Membership is RED-SEQUENCE PHOTOMETRIC selection, not spectroscopic.
